title: Name field on the 'done' step has no label, only a placeholder
detail: -- unlike every other text field in the app (e.g. the base-rate field in Settings, index.html:4707, which wraps its input in
failure: A user who fills in her name and then, minutes later, revisits the field (e.g. via 'Edit my setup') sees a populated text box with no visible or reliably-announced label reminding her what it's for; it's also the one field in the app that doesn't follow the app's own established labeling convention.
fix: Wrap it in the same pattern used everywhere else, keeping the placeholder as a secondary hint if desired.
